excerpts.author: lucassaldanhaconsensys
excerpts.content:
<@508125616940515329> 
```
participants:
  - el_type: ethereumjs
    el_image: ethereumjs-devnet-5-7f5c4c5:latest
    cl_type: teku
    cl_image: consensys/teku:develop

network_params:
  electra_fork_epoch: 1
  min_validator_withdrawability_delay: 1
  shard_committee_period: 1
  churn_limit_quotient: 16
  num_validator_keys_per_node: 256

snooper_enabled: true

additional_services:
  - dora
  
dora_params:
  image: "ethpandaops/dora:master-latest"
```

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
We now have the first clients interop-ing on pectra-devnet-5 specs 😄

There's still some missed slot issues and we haven't run through all the tests yet. But we're getting there!

I'll pin a kurtosis config if someone wants to run tests locally and verify interop with their own clients.

excerpts.author: parithosh
excerpts.content:
pectra-devnet-5
```
participants_matrix:
  el:
    - el_type: geth
      el_image: ethpandaops/geth:prague-devnet-5-f24d6f6
    - el_type: reth
      el_image: ethpandaops/reth:main-11bd9dd
    - el_type: nethermind
      el_image: ethpandaops/nethermind:pectra-devnet-5-52b679a
  cl:
    - cl_type: lighthouse
      cl_image: ethpandaops/lighthouse:unstable-a1b7d61
    - cl_type: teku
      cl_image: consensys/teku:develop
    - cl_type: nimbus
      cl_image: ethpandaops/nimbus-eth2:devnet-5-candidate-1-af895e8
    - cl_type: lodestar
      cl_image: ethpandaops/lodestar:unstable-d584aed
    - cl_type: grandine
      cl_image: ethpandaops/grandine:devnet5-3edeb45
    - cl_type: prysm
      cl_image: ethpandaops/prysm-beacon-chain:develop-0b16c79
      vc_image: ethpandaops/prysm-validator:develop-0b16c79
  
network_params:
  electra_fork_epoch: 1
  min_validator_withdrawability_delay: 1
  shard_committee_period: 1
  churn_limit_quotient: 16
additional_services:
  - dora
  - spamoor_blob
  - tx_spammer
dora_params:
  image: "ethpandaops/dora:master-latest"
snooper_enabled: true
spamoor_blob_params:
  throughput: 10 
  max_blobs: 2  
  max_pending: 40 
```
